event.text: I recommend you be seen in person today, not later this evening, at a service able to check your oxygen level and examine your chest; a Counsel clinician can stay involved in this thread but cannot measure your breathing remotely. Being winded walking to the bathroom with green phlegm needs hands-on evaluation. If that assessment can't be obtained promptly today, go to an emergency department instead of waiting. Call 911 now if you struggle to speak in full sentences, become drowsy or confused, your lips turn blue, or breathing suddenly worsens.
